case_number: Civil Appeal No. 4682 of 2022 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No. 1319 of 2019)
summary: Appeal filed by landlord against tenant for eviction and recovery of rent arrears; Trial Court struck off tenant's defence under Order XV Rule 5 CPC for non-payment/deposit of rent, upheld by Revisional Court; High Court reversed the order, citing discretion must be exercised cautiously; issue before Supreme Court: whether High Court was correct in reversing the striking off of defence; Court examined applicability of Order XV Rule 5 CPC when tenant disputes landlord-tenant relationship; decision turned on interpretation of procedural requirement and judicial discretion.
legal_provisions_cited: Order XV Rule 5, Code of Civil Procedure, 1908
Mukesh Singh & Ors. Vs. Ramesh Chand Solanki, 2012 (1) CAR, 93 Allahabad
final_judgment: The appeal was allowed, setting aside the High Court's judgment and restoring the Trial Court's order striking off the defence of the respondent.
